title: feat(types)!: adopt @objectstack/spec 15; drop value-erased spec/ui `…Schema` re-exports (#2561)
body:
Implements both halves of #2561 as one coherent types-package PR.

## 1. `/ui` re-export shape — decision (a)

Evidence gathered before deciding: **zero consumers** of the ~84 `…Schema` names anywhere in this repo (packages/apps/content, value- or type-level), no sibling-repo package depends on `@object-ui/types`, and since the names sat inside `export type` blocks they were **value-erased** — any import would have received `undefined` at runtime, so no working consumer can exist. Went with **(a)**: the schema names are dropped from the public surface; the inferred types (`DndConfig`, `SpecFormView`, …) are unchanged and the genuine value re-exports (`defineStack`, `ObjectStackSchema`, `SpecReportSchema`, …) keep working. `BreakpointColumnMapSchema` / `BreakpointOrderMapSchema` are dropped without a type replacement (spec exports no companion inferred type). `theme.ts`'s `ThemeModeSchema` was the same class of bug and is dropped too.

Guardrail: `packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-ui-schema-reexports.test.ts` pins the contract three ways — the dropped names are not runtime-exported, the genuine value exports stay defined, and a source scan fails if any spec/ui zod value ever reappears inside an `export type` block.

## 2. Spec pin `^14.6` → `^15.1.1`

All 14 workspace `package.json`s + lockfile. The issue predicted the bump was low-risk *modulo strict-mode fixture fallout* — validation found something better: ADR-0089 D3a's `.strict().transform(…)` pipes crash `z.toJSONSchema` over spec's lazySchema **proxies** (`Cannot set properties of undefined (setting 'ref')`), which broke Studio's spec-derived **Page** inspector schema (caught by `page-schema.test.ts`) and silently degraded the **View** inspector (no test existed). Root cause + fix upstream: objectstack-ai/framework#3021, which shipped in **`@objectstack/spec@15.1.1`** (15.1.0 predates it). Hence the **15.1.1** floor.

New `view-schema.test.ts` pins the previously-untested View-inspector derivation.

## Verification

- `@object-ui/types` `tsc --noEmit` clean under spec 15.1.1; guardrail test + full types suite **86 passed**.
- app-shell **Page + View inspector** schema tests **7 passed** against the real published `@objectstack/spec@15.1.1` (not a dist overlay).
- Full workspace suite **6852 passed / 0 failed** (24 skipped) against 15.1.1.
- Changeset: **major** on the fixed group (version-alignment policy: objectui major follows @objectstack major → next release is 15).

## Status

- [x] **Unblocked**: objectstack-ai/framework#3021 merged → `@objectstack/spec@15.1.1` published
- [x] Lockfile refreshed to 15.1.1, floor pinned `^15.1.1` across all 14 package.jsons, `main` merged in, full suite re-run green → ready for review

Closes #2561. Refs #2545, objectstack-ai/framework#2998.
